conflicts.description: Final printed table repeats Bell13 and Knocker14 at5J2-4 although they have different CPU controls, transistors, wires and downstream plugs. Schematic corroborates Bell13 at5J2-4 but does not establish Knocker14 in the retained controlled block. The complete printed claims are retained and the uncertain Knocker connection is omitted. A verified harness/board-specific record is needed. Resolution path: A curator or machine owner must supply a readable auxiliary-driver/knocker harness record or continuity/photo inspection on an identified production Taxi, recording both connector pins and wire colors. ROM pulses cannot settle this wiring.

Factory table PDF72 gives5J3-7:5J7-7; factory schematic PDF28 gives5J3-7:5J6-7 for Sol17/Q75/Blu-Brn. Its semantic bumper identity is settled but downstream plug is unasserted. Resolution path: A curator or machine owner must photograph or trace the identified production left-jet harness plug, confirming whether the Blu-Brn downstream lead reaches5J6-7 or5J7-7; compare the retained factory pages without guessing a typo.

Factory wiring table PDF72 names JOYRIDE Flasher (#89,1p); schematic PDF29 at identical Q6/5J2-1/5J6-1 instead names LEFT EJECT HOLE. ROM and retained VPX agree with flasher semantics but cannot settle the physical construction represented by that drawing. No physical type or population is promoted. Resolution path: A curator or machine owner must supply dated factory change documentation or identified production/prototype underside wiring photographs showing the load reached from Q6/5J2-1/5J6-1. The retained drawing and final table exist, but neither a software callback nor Ghidra proves the depicted construction.

mechanisms.behavior: Drain closes outhole10; coil1 clears the outhole into two gravity storage positions11/12. Coil2 releases the leading stored ball to manual shooter lane22. VPX stack starts with two balls, 11/12 occupied; outputs do not directly actuate the trough switches: ball movement does.
mechanisms.label: Two-ball trough / outhole / feeder

mechanisms.behavior: Manual plunger sends ball into Spinout bowl. Switch44 pulses per passage of the counter; ball collects at switch43 and coil7 kicks it into play. VPX InitKick330deg/force35 with angleVar2/forceVar3 is a physics clue, not a real travel time.
mechanisms.label: Manual shooter and Spinout bowl

mechanisms.behavior: Ball seats at35. AL23-800 plunger pivots the spring-return catapult arm, launching toward elevated wireform; return spring restores arm. VPX b3 force140/KickZ1 and Dracula helper transfer are modeled motion rather than extra real coils.
mechanisms.label: Catapult arm and wireform return

mechanisms.behavior: Ball-held contact13 closes on entry; output5 raises eject cam, releases ball toward playfield, then spring resets. VPX heading170deg/force20. No separate cam-home sensor.
mechanisms.label: Upper left JOYRIDE eject hole

mechanisms.behavior: Ball enters occupied switch36; output8 ejects through the saucer arm. Release is ball-driven; no coil-to-switch relationship is asserted. VPX180deg/force20.
mechanisms.label: Right lock eject hole

mechanisms.behavior: Three independently spring-latched drop targets report left/middle/right down at public1 via C11318 opto electronics. Common coil4 reset plate lifts all three and clears down contacts. Raised is the mechanical default; do not synthesize a switch edge merely because the ROM pulsed reset.
mechanisms.label: Middle passenger three-drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: Top/middle/bottom drop targets each latch down; common coil6 lifts reset plate. Target-down is public1, up0, with optical electronics.
mechanisms.label: Right PIN-BOT three-drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: Output9 controls the top gate route; spring/gravity restores released gate. Top entry23 is an independent passage sensor, not actuator feedback. VPX vpmSolWall TopGate changes collidable wall rather than modeling a real wall-moving motor.
mechanisms.label: Top controlled ball gate

mechanisms.behavior: Ball depresses skirt/leaf sensor; ROM-controlled special circuit pulls bumper ring through plunger/link, striking ball. Return spring restores ring. Physical special circuit must be derived through Williams PIA permutation; this is not a simulator ssSw slot.
mechanisms.label: Left jet bumper

mechanisms.behavior: Ball depresses skirt/leaf sensor; ROM-controlled special circuit pulls bumper ring through plunger/link, striking ball. Return spring restores ring. Physical special circuit must be derived through Williams PIA permutation; this is not a simulator ssSw slot.
mechanisms.label: Right jet bumper

mechanisms.behavior: Ball depresses skirt/leaf sensor; ROM-controlled special circuit pulls bumper ring through plunger/link, striking ball. Return spring restores ring. Physical special circuit must be derived through Williams PIA permutation; this is not a simulator ssSw slot.
mechanisms.label: Lower jet bumper

mechanisms.behavior: Ball stretches rubber and closes paired actuating contacts; software-controlled special output moves spring-return kicker arm. Retained VPX animates the sling without reporting the switch, a recreation deficiency that does not delete factory contacts.
mechanisms.label: Left slingshot kicker

mechanisms.behavior: Ball stretches rubber and closes paired actuating contacts; software-controlled special output moves spring-return kicker arm. Retained VPX animates the sling without reporting the switch, a recreation deficiency that does not delete factory contacts.
mechanisms.label: Right slingshot kicker

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button powers enabled local dual-winding FL11630 flipper. Normally-closed local EOS opens at end travel to cut high-power winding; holding winding stays powered while held. Return spring restores flipper. Host drives cabinet column82/84, core copies lane change57/58 and publishes synthetic group46/48; no separately published EOS sensor.
mechanisms.label: Left cabinet-wired lower flipper

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button powers enabled local dual-winding FL11630 flipper. Host drives cabinet column82/84, core copies lane change57/58 and publishes synthetic group46/48; no separately published EOS sensor.
mechanisms.label: Right cabinet-wired lower flipper

mechanisms.behavior: De-energized12 selects A coils1..8; energized12 selects C flashers25..32. The public C addresses are already demultiplexed; do not resend25 as1. Switch2 is core feedback generated from12, not physical relay sensing.
mechanisms.label: A/C relay bank selection

mechanisms.behavior: Separate relays open their normally-on illumination strings when public state1. Output10 is backbox insert GI;11 playfield GI. Coin-door transformer GI is independent always-on. Physical bulb count/socket map is incomplete; VPX GI collection has additional helpers.
mechanisms.label: Insert-board and playfield GI relays
